text:
Jordan: Quick flag — first-launch import modal is confusing. The dropdown default reads "No sample" and people think it's an error. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/1972-sample-modal.png

Lee: I noticed that too. On narrow widths the form + preview compete for space. Maybe collapse the preview under a chevron on mobile. :mobile_phone:

Ravi: Implementation note: the preview is an iframe that mounts immediately and causes layout shift (~200-300ms). We can lazy-load it after 250ms or on expand to reduce CLS.

Ana: Accessibility nits: modal must trap focus and restore to opener. Also ensure the importer uses `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` for inline errors. Right now a screen reader hears random status updates.

Jordan: Microcopy suggestion: change "Import sample" to "Add example project" and dropdown label from "Sample type" to "Choose a template" — clearer for new users.

Lee: Visual tweaks: thumbnail shadow is too heavy at 0.9 opacity; contrast on the overlay label falls below 4.5:1 on some thumbnails. Increase label bg or move label outside image.

Ravi: I'll prototype lazy-load and fix the submit race. Snippet I'll try in the PR:```html
<button class="import" aria-disabled="true">Add example project</button>
<iframe src="/preview/starter-todo" loading="lazy"></iframe>
```
Opening branch `eng/starter-import-lazy` later today.

onboarding-bot: Heads-up — run `track_event("first_launch.import_attempt")` for telemetry and tag @growth for funnel analysis.

Ana: Keyboard behaviour: Enter on a select shouldn't accidentally submit. Make the template chooser `role="combobox"` and handle keydown so Space/Enter open choices but don't trigger form submit. Also ensure Escape closes and focus returns correctly.

Lee: Mobile layout suggestion: move preview below form on narrow screens so DOM order = reading order. That preserves tab order without JS reordering.

Jordan: Good call. Let's run 8 quick moderated tests focused on "discoverability of template chooser" tomorrow 10:00am PT. Who can join?

Ravi: I can do dev support.

Lee: I can facilitate design tasks and visuals.

Ana: I'll run the a11y checklist and axe-ci against the branch.

Jordan: Great. After tests we'll decide if modal should be a slide-over on mobile. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
